north.evidence: Dales 1962, unnumbered citadel plan on printed page 5 (PDF page 2; plan library entry sutkagen-dor-01): an unlabelled arrow pointing up the page with a small circle on its shaft, at the right of the plan. No 'N', no meaning and no survey date are given on the plan.

scale.note: The scale bar's numeric labels are absent from the scan. Scale taken from the text on printed page 4: midway along the eastern wall (Operation B) the wall is 'approximately twenty-four feet thick at the base'; we take the two outline faces of the hatched east wall just north of trench B (y = 470 px) as 24 ft = 7.315 m. The bar's major ticks are 57.3 px apart, which this scale makes 9.75 m, consistent with an unlabelled 10 m division. Scale affects lengths and weights only, not bearings.
